modifier_claims.support_quote:
Infiltrate of atypical mononuclear cells around vessels
- Vascular damage with extravasated erythrocytes, leucocytoclasia, and fibrinoid degeneration
- Atypical cells positive for myeloperoxidase, CD15, CD43, CD45, CD68, TIA-1
On the extensor elbows extending down her forearms bilaterally and on her knees and shins were dozens of 1–2 cm oedematous pink-red papules with a darker red-violet central zone
presented with a 10-day history of pruritic lesions on her arms and legs

Complex karyotype with chromosomal abnormalities
- FISH showed deletions of 5q and 7q in 54% of bone marrow cells
